subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses present, past and future tense correctly

show.line: Yesterday I played. Today I play. Tomorrow I will play. The verb changes with the time!

rounds.prompt: Yesterday I ... to school. Which word fits?
rounds.praise: Yes! Yesterday is the past. Walked.

rounds.prompt: Tomorrow we ... a cake. Which words fit?
rounds.praise: Yes! Tomorrow is the future. Will bake.

rounds.prompt: Every day Gogo ... tea. Which word fits?
rounds.praise: Yes! Every day is now. Drinks.

rounds.prompt: Jump. Say it in the past, like yesterday.
Past, now or future? Put each word in its group.

rounds.story: Last week Zinzi lost her tooth. Today a new one is growing. Which picture shows what happened last week?
rounds.praise: Yes! Last week she lost her tooth.

rounds.prompt: Which word tells us about the future?

hints: Yesterday is the past. Many past verbs end with ed.
Tomorrow is the future. Use will before the verb.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Yesterday I ... my room.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Yesterday I will clean my room!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Yesterday is the past. Yesterday I cleaned my room.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Yesterday I cleaned my room. Tomorrow I will clean it again!

parent_line: Can use past, present and future tense, like played, play and will play.
